genericProblem: A handwritten backend consumer duplicates catalog capability strings rather than referring to the generated authority constants, causing literal-boundary controls to fail and permitting semantic drift.

counterexamples.reason: Generated authority is allowed to contain the frozen capability values.
Generated adapter is excluded from the handwritten consumer denominator.

findings.evidence: The P1-required frontend architecture gate reports R5_ADMIN_CATALOG_BACKEND_LITERAL against WorkspaceCapabilityRequirementCatalog.java, which contains 44 quoted BC-* values; all 13 distinct values exist in WorkspaceAuthorizationCatalog.CapabilityKeys.

preventionDispositions.owningSourceOrControl: tools/verify-gates/cli.mjs frontend R5_ADMIN_CATALOG_BACKEND_LITERAL and its injected literal self-test
preventionDispositions.action: Keep the gate fail-closed for handwritten consumers and use generated CapabilityKeys references in the finite denominator.
